name: Cynthia Papa-Lentini
reason: Too thin for a full page: beyond her one Kripalu programme (The Magic of Spring, 18 to 23 Apr 2027, co-led with Beth Grace, who is already planned) there are only her tarot reading sessions; her site's workshops are past (Nov 2025, an undated Roots to Wings day) or 'notify me' pages with no dates or prices (tarot mentorship, grief and death workshops), and she has no books, no teaching videos and no free resources.
